Horse_Swiveling_Ears.description: With swiveling ears that can rotate independently, this horse-like creature possesses an unparalleled ability to detect even the subtlest sounds, enhancing its awareness and making it an acute sentinel in the wilds of the game world.

Donkey_Long_Listening_Ears.description: With elongated, highly attuned ears that swivel like radar dishes, this donkey component enhances one's perception, granting the user an uncanny ability to detect the slightest sounds and even subtle ground vibrations, making them ever vigilant and aware of their surroundings.

Rhino_Thick_Trumpet_Ears.description: Enormous, horn-rimmed ears, chiseled from living bone and draped in thick, protective membranes, protrude from the rhino's head, enhancing its already acute senses and adding a layer of defensive armor against aerial attacks.

Deer_Large_Cupped_Ears.description: Gnarled and keen, the large cupped ears of this ancient ungulate swivel with preternatural grace, amplifying the subtlest rustles and whispers of the forest, granting the creature unparalleled vigilance and agility in the dense underbrush.

Boar_Bristly_Ears.description: Bristly ears, thick with coarse hair, twitch and quiver with heightened sensitivity, granting the wearer an acute awareness of their surroundings and a rugged resilience.

Camel_Furry_Desert_Ears.description: These large, sensitive desert ears, reminiscent of a camel's, are perched atop a player's head, enhancing their perception and alertness to potential threats while also granting a natural resistance to the harsh winds of arid environments.

Moose_Enormous_Satellite_Ears.description: The enormous satellite ears of this formidable moose are not just a marvel of ungulate anatomy but a beacon of heightened perception, swiveling with preternatural grace to detect the faintest rustle or whisper of danger, bestowing upon the creature an almost omniscient awareness of its surroundings.

Goat_Alert_Pointed_Ears.description: Sharp, pointed ears twitch and swivel with keen sensitivity, granting the bearer heightened perception and agility, allowing them to detect the slightest movement or sound, a trait reminiscent of nimble ungulates in the wild.

Spectral_Steed_Ghost_Ears.description: These ghostly appendages, translucent and ethereal, enhance the wearer's wisdom and perception, granting an acute awareness of magical auras and an ever-vigilant alertness, traits reminiscent of spectral beings and undead creatures.

Zombie_Ox_Tattered_Ear_Holes.description: Tattered and decayed, the once-proud ears of the Zombie Ox flap loosely from its head, a grim testament to the relentless ravages of undeath, granting it an uncanny resistance to poison while dulling its already dim senses.
